commit.message:
feat(2d): arc turns and their radius on Face, 2D Contour and Slot

Face and 2D Contour get `blend_radius` beside their `blend_turns`.
Slot gets `blend_turns` and `blend_radius`.

- 2D Contour: the air-side corner arcs take the radius. No radius is the
  tool radius, as before.
- Face: a radius below half the row spacing turns each row end on two
  quarter arcs with a straight step, one radius outside the overrun
  line. No radius is the semicircle, as before. With a radius, rows
  spaced wider than the tool diameter turn on arcs too.
- Slot: each row-end corner of the serpentine turns on one tangent arc
  inside the cutter-center stadium (new module `slot_turns`). The note
  states the corner rest.

The parameter door refuses a radius below 0.01 mm. The generators refuse
a radius past the tool radius. The project file writes the keys only
when set, and the digest reads the radius only when the option is on, so
a default operation keeps its path, its file and its stamp.

Fixes #1759

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(2d): keep the Face corner arc at or below the requested radius

A Face row turn whose half spacing exceeded the radius by less than
0.005 mm took the semicircle, which is larger than the radius. Now it
takes corner arcs shrunk to keep the straight-step floor, or stays
sharp (named Tiny refusal) when those would be below the arc resolution.

Pinned by blend::law::a_short_step_never_turns_on_an_arc_larger_than_the_radius
and arc_turn_kinds::a_face_turn_never_exceeds_the_radius_when_the_straight_step_is_short.

Refs #1759
